review.recipe: Single chilled narrow stemmed glass; cloudy rose-amber shaken rum/vermouth/lime Floridita riff; single green lime peel laid on rim, no ice or foam cap.
review.personality: Work jacket with worn cuff and button, consulted blank-cover booklets, quiet daily service. Morning/night paradox removed. Lime halves support recipe without dominating.
review.world: Dark walnut reading-room bar, burgundy chair, one warm source, restrained neutral shadows and grain.
issues: Supporting lime halves both look intact rather than one visibly squeezed. Hero drink itself correct; do not treat as source of physical serve change.
